failures.rootCause: The agent read only the first ~35 lines of the decompressor source before declaring it understood the format, then spent the entire budget writing successive encoders that were never validated against the real decompressor on a tiny input. It repeatedly generated a full-size output and only then piped it through ./decomp, getting empty output each time with no isolation of which stage broke. Because it never established a working minimal round-trip, every one of the ~90 bash iterations was blind guessing. The session ended with an artifact that was actually a Python traceback written to data.comp.
